newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel said to be holding four Iranians.
newsitem.headline: Israel said to be holding four Iranians.

text.p: An organisation working on behalf of prisoners said on Friday that Israel was secretly holding four Iranians believed to have been kidnapped by a pro-Israeli militia in Lebanon since 1982.
"We have received a tip that Israel was holding four Iranians secretly in a military prison in Israel," Ahmed Habiballah, director of the Nazareth-based Prisoner's Friends Society, told Reuters.
Shai Bazak, a spokesman of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, told Reuters of the report: "I asked about it and it is not true."

Habiballah, who specialises in tracking down missing people, said he believed that the four were the Iranians who were kidnapped by Christian Lebanese Forces militiamen in July 1982, less than two months after Israeli forces invaded Lebanon. But he stressed he was not certain of the identity of the prisoners.
"Of course we don't know for sure if the four being held by Israel are the four missing since 1982. But we believe they are," he said.

The missing Iranians are Mohsen Mussavi, Iranian charge d'affaires at Iran's Beirut embassy, Ahmad Motavasselian, a Revolutionary Guard commander at the embassy, Kazem Akhavan, a photographer, and driver Taqi Rastegar Moqaddam.
The four were said to have been killed shortly after they were kidnapped. But Habiballah said Iran's ambassador in Lebanon said he believed they were alive.

He said the sources who disclosed the information had said that the four were being held in the late 1980s at Israel's Atlit prison, a military-run detention facility which he said is completely closed to the outside world.
Habiballah said he had written letters to Israeli officials asking for the names of the four.
Israel holds scores of Lebanese citizens, including a pro-Iranian Hizbollah cleric kidnapped in south Lebanon.
Habiballah said he believed Israel was keeping the Iranians for possible exchange for Israeli servicemen missing in action and said to be held by Iran and Hizbollah.
